title: Data Export and Processing Pipelines
text: Survey Solutions data extraction involves queuing export jobs server, monitoring progress, downloading resulting archive, transforming raw files labeled, clean analytical tables. SurveySolutionsAPIv2 implements modern v2 Export API provides high-level pipelines handle entire lifecycle automatically.

title: Data Export and Processing Pipelines
text: Survey Solutions supports multiple export formats: - Tabular: Tab-delimited flat files (.tab). - STATA: Stata .dta files variable labels value labels. - SPSS: SPSS .sav files. - Parquet: Modern columnar storage, ideal big data workflows. - Binary: Binary format images, audio, attachments. - DDI: Data Documentation Initiative XML metadata.

Monitor interview workflow statuses. 2. Take supervisory actions (commenting, approving, rejecting, reassigning). 3. Query real-time response distributions. 4. Process granular event paradata (timings, pauses, spatial traces).

title: Questionnaires, Structure, and Codebooks
text: Survey Solutions questionnaires sophisticated hierarchical documents comprising sections, multi-level rosters, conditional skip patterns, inline validation rules, static text instructions, calculated variables. SurveySolutionsAPIv2, can extract entire questionnaire specification milliseconds clean, normalized flat tables. enables automated codebook generation, survey documentation, pre-fieldwork verification routing logic.

title: Questionnaires, Structure, and Codebooks
text: extract structure questionnaire, supply QuestionnaireId (GUID), version, specify operation.type = "structure": function returns named list 4 structured data.table elements: q: Question, roster, variable metadata. val: Validation rules, expressions, messages, severity labels. v: Backward-compatible alias val. answers: Categorical question answer codes, labels, category mapping.
code: library(SurveySolutionsAPIv2)  # Extract questionnaire structure quest_struct <- suso_getQuestDetails(   questID = "17a9fa22-1ef6-46d2-8c30-426aa876f273",   version = 1,   operation.type = "structure",   include_raw = FALSE ) names(quest_struct) #> [1] "q"       "val"     "v"       "answers"

text: SurveySolutionsAPIv2 comprehensive, production-ready R interface World Bank’s Survey Solutions Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) Computer-Assisted Web Interviewing (CAWI) platform. Built modern httr2, package supersedes previous httr-based implementation (SurveySolutionsAPI). covers full current REST API (v1 v2) well complementary GraphQL queries mutations, providing robust foundation survey operations, quality control dashboards, automated data pipelines.

title: Comprehensive API Access to Your Survey Solutions Server Using 'httr2'
text: Modern httr2 Architecture: Fast, resilient HTTP communications structured error handling via cli automatic retries transient server errors. High Concurrency & Scalability: Built-support parallel asynchronous requests, dramatically reducing processing time creating thousands assignments querying census-scale staff rosters. Recursive Questionnaire Parser: High-performance tree traversal (extracts 900+ questions ~0.1s) capturing question hierarchy, static text, calculated variables, routing expressions (ConditionExpression), Designer validations (val), categorical answer options (answers). Clean Flat Tables: Default include_raw = FALSE produces pure atomic data.table outputs serialize cleanly data.table::fwrite(), opt-include_raw = TRUE retain raw JSON nodes. Automated Data Export Pipelines: End--end management server-side export jobs (Tabular, Stata, SPSS, Parquet) automatic polling, ZIP extraction, variable labeling, multi-language translation merging (exportClass). Field & Workspace Administration: Multi-tenant workspace management, bulk staff creation data frames (suso_createUSER()), preloaded sample assignments, offline basemap management. Quality Control & Paradata: Interview workflow tracking, question-level commenting, supervisor approval/rejection, response rate distributions, enriched paradata (active duration, pause detection, spatial GPS event traces). R Shiny Ready: Native progress bars, customizable user notifications, interactive display methods via DT plotly.
